posts.author: KermexRPG
posts.body: I know that by default the Guard command reduces damage taken by 50%, but is this for all kind of damage? Physical and magical?

posts.author: TG22
posts.body: Yes, by default, the guard commands reduces incoming damage by 50% (unless you have a different guard rate), for all damage, except certain hits, IIRC.
